name: Cal.diy
description: Cal.diy is an open-source scheduling platform. This script deploys it in a Debian 12 LXC using Docker Compose, with support for bundled PostgreSQL or a remote PostgreSQL database.

install_methods.description: Creates a Debian 12 LXC and installs Cal.diy with Docker Compose. The installer prompts for the public URL and the database mode.

notes: Set a public URL reachable by users, ideally behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS.
The installer can use the PostgreSQL service from the upstream Docker Compose stack or a remote PostgreSQL database.
Inside the container, use caldiy-update for application updates and caldiy-logs to follow logs.
Local access is available on port 3000 before reverse proxy integration.
